ApplyScript: if self.Vars ~= nil and self.Vars:ContainsKey("SunExpSolarRadianceHook") then return end; if self.Vars ~= nil then self.Vars:set_Item("SunExpSolarRadianceHook", "1"); end; self:AddEvent("Action", function() local b = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance"); if b == nil then return end; local gain = b.buffConfig.Level * 5; if gain <= 0 then return end; self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("buff_extraordinary", tostring(gain)); end);
